title: Long Night
paragraphs: Takt, the child of god? He can wield multiple Hero weapons? Grant him clemency?
What nonsense is this fool spouting? Ah, perhaps he, too, is one of Takt’s faction. They likely thought that no matter what plan we devised, Takt would turn the tables on us.

But when the lid was lifted, it was entirely one-sided. And now, they’re trying to defend him at the last moment. If they continue to plead for him even when it’s so clear he’s evil, they’ll die too, you know?
“It’s not happening. I’ve hated that guy for a long time. And now that he’s shown his true colors, there’s no need to let him go since he’s not even a real Hero, right?”
It seems the Pig King has no intention of budging on this, which is reassuring.
“But Takt has contributed through numerous inventions and business ventures! Punishing him would destabilize the economy! And he’s a Seven Star Hero with the power to wield multiple weapons!”
“Hmm… I understand your point. I’ll acknowledge only the benefits that the criminal Takt has brought to my country.”
What? After all this, does he intend to release Takt? If that’s the case, then he’s just as guilty. I’ll make his blood rust my spear. Just as that thought crossed my mind, the Pig King spoke.
“But still… the Four Holy Heroes are more important than the Seven Stars.”
“But, but…!”
“Besides, even though he raised his level to 300 and wielded three weapons, he couldn’t even put up a fight against the Four Holy Heroes. A guy like that is useless.”
The Pig King understands the situation. However, his tone feels strangely casual.
“And you—you’re connected to Takt, aren’t you? Off with your head.”
The Pig King’s glare made the vassal freeze before soldiers seized him.
“Gh… Let go of me! Takt is the true kinggggg!”
The former vassal was dragged away, screaming. Oh, so he really was connected to Takt. It seems the Pig King is an elite among pigs. Now that the nuisance is gone…
“What do you plan to do with Takt?”
“Buhuhuhu… I’ll enjoy him for a while. And… I’ll also use him to smoke out the rest of his allies.”
I recall hearing that the Pig King has a sharp nose when it comes to political matters. He’ll probably sniff them out like truffles. Just like he did with that vassal just now.
“It’s done! Gaelion has become the true Dragon Emperor now!”
Rival burst out of Takt’s dragon’s corpse, drenched in blood. Ren and Itsuki looked absolutely horrified.
“Ah, Father, you got dirty! I’ll clean you up!”
Rival started licking himself clean, wiping off the blood. Then, he chanted a water spell to purify himself. Takt’s dragon remains a nuisance even in death. The harem is a mess.
“Uh, Gaelion-chan… Is Takt’s dragon really dealt with?”
“It’s fine!”
“There’s no chance any lingering will in the fragments will come after us later, right?”
At Itsuki’s words, Ren and Father silently glanced at him before turning their gazes back to Rival.
“It’s all good! Gaelion overwrote everything, so there’s nothing left!”
“Overwrote…”
“A save file, huh?”
Father and Ren each muttered to themselves. But Ren… is that really the best way to put it? Regardless, dragons truly have some grotesque biological traits.
“Gaelion has gained all sorts of knowledge! Now I can be someone indispensable to Naofumi!”
Looking pleased with himself, Rival flapped his wings excitedly. Know your place, you fool! Your limits are obvious!
“Gaelion wants to become even stronger! I’ll also break past my class-up limit!”
“Yeah, I’ll be counting on you from now on.”
“Right!”
At last, we can finally achieve a class-up breakthrough.
“For now, we need to secretly get rid of this corpse.”
“It seems the work has already begun.”

After a short while, a reset-to-level-1 Takt was brought in. I had considered finishing him off before anyone had the chance to rescue him, but… at this point, it’s simply impossible. It seems the King of Faubrey is quite skilled when it comes to torture. He was so eager that there was no stopping him.
“Mmmph!”

With a cloth stuffed into his mouth, Takt resisted as best he could, but he was completely powerless. The pigs that had accompanied him had also been reset and were unable to move from the backlash. They were not only bound but also afflicted with a continuous debuff that suppressed their abilities. Even if they could move, at level 1, they wouldn’t stand a chance against anyone here, nor could they escape.
“Now then, Takt, you criminal who slew the Heroes. I shall brand you with a high-density slave crest and make you my slave. You’d best abandon any foolish hope of being rescued.”
Buhuhuhu… the Pig King laughed.
“The history of slave crests is long. Takt, you consider yourself a scholar, do you not? Then surely you recognize the forbidden crest from ages past that I am about to bestow upon you?”
At the Pig King’s command, the royal magicians began performing some sort of enslavement ritual on Takt. It seems they possess some rather advanced techniques.

Later, I learned that, in theory, the crest was impossible to remove. Furthermore, it paralyzes all four limbs, making movement impossible without the master’s command. Additionally, any experience points or magic power the branded person would have gained are instead transferred to the master. Well, maybe there are ways to overcome it through technical means, but with the Pig King’s declaration, it seems Takt has no hope of surviving.
“Mmuuuuuuhhhhhh!!”
Takt struggled violently, but in the end, he couldn’t resist. The slave crest was engraved upon him.

“Now then, Four Holy Heroes. I am most satisfied with today’s feast. Tomorrow, we will begin the roundup of Takt’s faction. Until then, I grant you some time to rest. Please, relax and enjoy yourselves.”
“Uhh…”
Father let out a troubled sigh.
“Naofumi-san, in the previous loop, was this really the outcome you wished for?” Itsuki asked Father, seeming to have grasped what was happening.

That’s a tricky question. The previous Father was a kind-hearted man, so he may have only seen the Pig King as a lecher. Moreover, back then, he had lost many people to the Dragon Emperor. Perhaps he had resigned himself to the necessity of this outcome.
“I don’t know what my past self would’ve done! But isn’t this outcome even crueler than killing him outright? I mean, sure, Sakura-chan was badly injured, and he did try to kill us, but…”
“What are you acting so shocked for? Naofumi-san, you were grinning smugly in the carriage earlier, weren’t you?”
“Yeah, but still! Well… I mean, at least the women around Takt will apparently become King Faubrey’s concubines, so their futures are secure, right?”

Oh? Does Father not know? Most who end up in the Pig King’s care don’t live long. But that’s something he’ll learn soon enough. If Ren and the others don’t seek the truth, they can spare themselves the pain. The previous Father likely never knew either.
“I see… being forced into a relationship with someone you don’t love… and on top of that…”
Itsuki trailed off. Well, he is still a minor.
“But… for those who condoned the killing of a Hero and even attempted to overthrow the state, perhaps this is a fitting punishment.”
At Ren’s words, Itsuki let out a deep sigh.
“After everything that’s happened… I guess I can never speak of justice again…”
“No… in the end, we prevented countless lives from getting caught up in unnecessary conflict. In a way, this is justice too.”
“If we had let Takt run free, the conflict would have escalated even further… right?”
As Father spoke with a complicated expression, the pigs started to make a ruckus.
“Buuh!”
“Buhi—!”
I’m not sure what they said, but judging from the unpleasant expressions on Ren and Itsuki’s faces, it was nothing good. Father’s gaze changed. Then, he turned to Takt and his followers and spoke.

“I’ve only heard bits and pieces about your other crimes. But you ignored the world’s crisis, condoned criminal acts, and even conspired in them. Your sins are heavy. You should have known this was a possible outcome. If you weren’t prepared for it, then you were far too naive. You are being punished for your own crimes.”

That’s right. I recall hearing that marriage to the Pig King is considered a punishment for serious criminals among the nobility of various nations. If their crimes were minor, their punishment wouldn’t be as severe as execution disguised as marriage. I can’t say for sure if the Pig King himself is capable of such discernment, but regardless, the crime of turning a blind eye to the murder of a Hero, conspiring in it, and even keeping secret the knowledge of Level Cap Removal—a crucial key to saving the world—is far too great for Takt alone to bear.
“…We are the Four Holy Heroes. We promise that we will not fabricate any crimes.”
“Yes. You will be judged under proper scrutiny. If you are truly innocent, I will personally pressure the Faubrey King to make accommodations for you.”
“But if you are guilty, there will be no mercy.”

Father and the others are quite kind. That said, there was no chance these people would get off without punishment in the end. It was only later that we learned that not only Takt but the pigs as well had committed countless other crimes. First, bribery of ministers and officials. Then, large-scale organized actions to overthrow the state. Looting of restricted areas. Research on forbidden technology. And most notably—kidnapping and forced labor. Apparently, Takt’s new technological projects required far more manpower than was available. So, the pigs used their authority to forcibly procure workers. It’s not hard to imagine how they “secured” those people. And lastly—murder. In this world, killing isn’t uncommon, and I’ve done it myself, so I won’t say anything about that. But they killed the wrong people. Not just in Faubrey, but reports came in from various countries. It seems that many people who were inconvenient for the pigs simply ended up dead. For example, Takt would kill debt collectors to “rescue” pigs drowning in debt, and the pigs would assist him. They also wiped out enemy factions as a show of force and did as they pleased. Now that I think about it, I recall that Filo-tan’s personal doctor fled to Father’s territory after losing a power struggle. I believe they came from Faubrey…

Could it be? At the very least, in the first world, the doctor was definitely one of the victims. In any case, these crimes were all swept under the rug using their authority. With all these additional charges stacking up, the pigs were handed over to the Pig King along with Takt. Compared to this, the Itsuki from the previous world was adorable. As a side note, there’s a strong suspicion that Takt’s father was eliminated by Takt’s own group. It’s said that while he was alive, he strongly opposed Takt and the pigs’ actions. Then, one day, he simply vanished.
“Bubuu!”
The screaming pigs and the cheerful Pig King left a strong impression. This place is a pig farm. I feel sick—I just want to leave.
“Now then, who shall I have fun with tonight?”
The Pig King grinned as he eyed Takt’s pigs.
“King Faubrey, please select only those whose guilt has been confirmed.”
“Bow Hero, I understand. Worry not—I enjoy a bit of anticipation myself.”
Itsuki looked absolutely disgusted. It seems he still has some sense of purity left. But honestly, I have no idea what the Pig King meant by “worry not.”
“Bubu! Bububububu!”
The pigs seemed to be pleading with Takt for help, but they had no means of resistance.
“Now then, criminal Takt. The night has only just begun.”
Thus, the long, dark night of Takt’s life had begun.

Will he survive until dawn? For making Father cry in the first world, for killing the villagers, for slaughtering the Filolials, and for wreaking havoc across countless worlds— This is his punishment. And so, with our business concluded, we returned to the guest rooms in the castle.
